notes: Hanfield is printed 'HANIFIELD'-like lettering; recorded as Hanfield Street. Hanfield is 60 ft wide and its north edge is at or just beyond the plate cut; the solid line running inside it is the 6 in. water pipe, not an edge; centres taken 90 px north of the south lot line. Jerome/Hanfield: no continuation of Jerome north of Hanfield visible (plate top), kind uncertain. '?' at 3327,268: a narrow (about 30 ft) stub going north from Hanfield in a notch of the plate, lettered 'GEO...' (cut off); may be an alley or not a street. Florida continues north of Hanfield in a plate notch. Powers Street: only the north edge (y about 7130) is on the plate; a continuous line at y about 7185 is taken as the plate border / approximate centre, so y of the two Powers crossings is uncertain by about 25 px; whether Sylvan and Edgewood continue south is off the plate. No street crossings between the creek (y 1900) and Hoffner Avenue inside the strip: Wesleyan-side Kirby Heirs tract and the West Branch only. The north-south avenue west of the strip (centre x about 1830) and its crossings with Wolcott and Kearsarge lie outside x 1940.
